database_specific.remediation_guidance: Enforces object tag masking and rejects client tag overrides.

details:
### Vulnerability Condition: Snowflake Tag-Based Masking & Object Tagging Bypass

**Category**: Improper Access Control / Masking Bypass
**CWE**: CWE-284
**Target Tool**: `settle_trade_order`

#### Vulnerable Behavior
Permits tag overrides and omits object tag masking policies.

#### Secure Mitigation
Enforces object tag masking and rejects client tag overrides.

#### Description
Tag overrides or untagged views leak confidential counterparty data.
summary: Snowflake Tag-Based Masking & Object Tagging Bypass in Snowflake Trading & Risk Target (snowflake-trading)
